marks.reason: Attributes the formal notice to the Musk buyer group and describes it as an exercise of a claimed termination right, not as proof that the agreement ended.
Identifies the alleged failure to provide requested fake- or spam-account data and attributes that allegation to Musk’s counsel.
Correctly attributes to Twitter its rejection of the notice as invalid, denial of breach, and position that the agreement remained in force.
Identifies USD 54.20 per share as the agreed price at which the board intended to close, not as a realized return.
Correctly describes specific performance as a remedy Twitter reserved the right to seek, not as relief a court had granted.
Distinguishes the buyer’s notice from an uncontested termination and the board’s intent from a guaranteed closing. Both outcomes remained unresolved at the cutoff.
